verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents the full loop: importing robots and scenes (URDF, MJCF, CAD, USD), assembling scenes with materials, physics and sensor models, and simulating with PhysX or Newton plus RTX and physics-based sensors. It also documents deformable and soft-body solvers and software- or hardware-in-the-loop evaluation before real deployment. One community report describes sim-to-real drift from GPU physics-step ordering in complex scenarios; this is a general caveat on physics fidelity (it names MuJoCo too), not a concrete contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of physics and sensor-model realism, and evidence that addresses reported sim-to-real drift in complex contact scenarios.
